images.filename: Steam launch of the HMS Cressy at the Port of Scheveningen in The Hague, 1914.jpg
images.caption: Steam launch of the armoured cruiser HMS Cressy, at the Port of Scheveningen in The Hague, 1914. Dutch authorities found it drifting empty on sea, after the HMS Cressy was torpedoed and sunk by a German submarine on 22 September 1914.
images.alt: Steam launch of the armoured cruiser HMS Cressy, at the Port of Scheveningen in The Hague, 1914. Dutch authorities found it drifting empty on sea, after the HMS Cressy was torpedoed and sunk by a German submarine on 22 September 1914.
